description:
i hosted a very serious game jam last month with over 3500 games and 14,000 incredibly talented participants, who all had 1 week to make a game with the theme "spin to win". so here i am to present my favorite entries in no particular order

play the very serious games here: https://itch.io/jam/theveryseriousjuniperdevgamejam/entries

thank you to our very serious jam sponsors:
- Click this link https://boot.dev/?promo=JUNIPERDEV and use my code JUNIPERDEV to get 25% off your first payment for boot.dev.
- Learn more about Unreal Engine for Indie Games here: https://epic.gm/influencer-game-jam
- CrazyGames connects over 3,000 developers with 55+ million players at https://developer.crazygames.com/_
